data.spec:
Atech ESP32-S3 board → laptop over USB serial, 115200 baud, one JSON object per line (observed 2026-11-05 on macOS port /dev/cu.usbmodem*):
{"type":"event","payload":{"event_type":"sensor","key":<string>,"value":<number|string>,"unit"?:<string>,"source":<string>}}
Observed keys:
- dist_min_distance (mm, source distance_sensor, 8x8 ToF) – ~250 idle, drops to ~30 when an object/hand is over it
- imu_tilt (deg) and imu_orientation (string, e.g. "unknown") – source icm40608
- th_temperature (C) and th_humidity (%) – source aht20
Screen/LED/button/speaker not seen in the stream yet (may be absent or event-only). Laptop→board command format not yet known.
